physicalNotes: Radius 0.49 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract): 340,893 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.531 +/- 0.021 solar masses from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3539 +/- 59 K from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
